en: The postcard features an early 20th-century black-and-white image of a grand historical building with ornate architectural details, identified as the 'Kaiserliches Postamt' (Imperial Post Office). There are people and a horse visible in front of the building. The border has red printed text, and the image is overlaid with handwritten German script. On the reverse side, there is museum branding ('Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont') and stamp/postmark information, addressed to a person in Potsdam, Germany.
